sessions.abstract: Organizations with data residency and digital sovereignty requirements face a critical question: how do you move workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS Outposts without disrupting compliance posture or operations? This Level 300 session distills lessons from migrating customers to Outposts across industries, organization sizes, and migration strategies. We walk through the processes that delivered results, the quantifiable outcomes we measured, and the critical mistakes we learned to avoid. You leave with a practical playbook for selecting the right migration approach, navigating common blockers, and accelerating Outposts adoption. We also cover transitioning from first-generation to second-generation Outposts hardware.

sessions.title: Workload Identity Federation in multicloud environments
sessions.abstract: Eliminating long-lived credentials across clouds is essential for secure multicloud operations. This session presents three proven identity federation patterns: using SPIFFE/SPIRE for cryptographic workload identity across Kubernetes clusters, leveraging native OIDC providers from GKE and Azure to assume AWS IAM roles with short-lived tokens, and federating Kubernetes service accounts across cloud boundaries. We walk through architecture decisions, trust policy design, and security best practices for each approach - covering GCP Workload Identity, Microsoft Entra ID federation, and cross-cluster OIDC. Attendees leave with actionable blueprints for credential-free multicloud access.

sessions.title: Governing autonomous AI agents across cloud boundaries
sessions.abstract: When autonomous agents coordinate across cloud boundaries, who enforces the rules — and how do you revoke access instantly when one goes rogue? In this chalk talk, we whiteboard governed multi-agent coordination: Cedar as a portable policy engine across AWS, Azure, and GCP, A2A protocol for cross-cloud agent communication, and a kill switch for instant revocation. The audience picks the scenario — flight delays, trade failures, or healthcare cancellations — and we draw how policy, identity, and coordination work at each boundary crossing.

sessions.title: Scaling Interactive GenerativeAI at Netflix with AWS Local Zones
sessions.abstract: Generative AI VFX and Animation teams at Netflix require the latest GPU hardware for creative workflows including real-time rendering, VFX editorial, and color correction. These workloads demand low-latency access to high-performance compute close to creative teams. AWS Local Zones make this possible by placing G7e instances with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPUs in the Los Angeles metro. Netflix's Studio GenAI Infrastructure, including GenAI Sessions and Universal Compute Service, leverages Local Zones to serve just-in-time combinations of software and hardware in secure, isolated sandbox environments. Tools like ComfyUI and AIToolkit with complex dependencies run on task-oriented, elastic GPU assignments, so Netflix scales creative AI workloads efficiently without managing physical infrastructure.

sessions.title: Build your AI-powered VMware migration factory with AWS Outposts
sessions.abstract:
In this hands-on workshop, learn how to build an AI-driven migration factory that transforms
manual VMware-to-AWS migration into an automated, repeatable pipeline. Using real fleet data
patterns from large-scale telco deployments, you'll configure automated discovery agents, build
ML rightsizing models that recommend optimal Outposts instance placements, design storage
optimization strategies that reduce EBS costs by 60–80% through intelligent tiering and hybrid
array integration, and deploy generative AI transforms that modernize legacy OS and application
code in-flight. By the end of this workshop, you'll have a working prototype migration pipeline
you can adapt to your own VMware estate — whether it's 500 VMs or 50,000.

sessions.title: How Adobe unified multicloud observability with open source
sessions.abstract:
Adobe operates production services across AWS and Azure, but 20+ monitoring tools and per-cloud dashboards turned every cross-cloud incident into a translation problem before debugging could begin. In this session, hear how Adobe standardized on OpenTelemetry and consolidated to four open-source technologies (Cortex,
Grafana Tempo, FluentBit, and Grafana) with AWS as the operational hub processing 1M+ trace samples per second. The result was a single pane of glass for every engineer regardless of where workloads run, and multi-million dollar savings through telemetry compression. Walk away with a proven, vendor-independent playbook for multicloud observability built on open source and open standards.

sessions.title: Gemini gets closer to traders with AWS Outposts and AWS Local Zones
sessions.abstract: Gemini, a NASDAQ-listed crypto exchange, serves trading clients with diverse latency and infrastructure needs. Using AWS Outposts at its NY5 colocation facility, Gemini provides sub-millisecond connectivity via cross-connects. With AWS Local Zones in NYC, cloud-native traders achieve sub-2ms latency through VPC Peering—an 80% improvement—with provisioning in minutes instead of months. The AWS Region offers a fully managed API for customers prioritizing simplicity, including agentic trading systems connecting via MCP. Hear how Gemini architected a tiered connectivity model that meets customers where they are, from HFT firms to AI-driven agents to university traders onboarded in days.

sessions.title: Architectures for ultra-low latency with accelerated networking on AWS Outposts
sessions.abstract: This session covers networking on AWS Outposts Gen2, from scalable multi-site topologies to ultra-low latency bare metal deployments for financial trading. We explore the Gen2 dedicated Network rack, LGW routing domains for segmentation, and Intra-VPC and Inter-VPC communication. We then expand to multi-site interconnections spanning Outposts and Local Zones, extended VPC designs, and resilient architectures grounded in Well-Architected principles. Finally, we dive into bare metal instances with high-throughput accelerated networking, kernel bypass, NIC selection, and rack topology for co-located workloads where every microsecond matters. This is an interactive session driven by attendee questions and real-world challenges.

sessions.title: Architecting for digital sovereignty: Choosing your AWS hybrid cloud infrastructure
sessions.abstract: Digital sovereignty requirements vary widely across government, defense, healthcare, and financial services. In this session, we use real-world case studies to compare architectural differences across AWS Dedicated Local Zones, AWS Outposts within the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, and AWS Regions. We examine how data residency boundaries, network separation, operational controls, and cryptographic key management differ across these options. We then demonstrate how to configure account access, data residency controls, and network ingress/egress policies for strict versus moderate requirements, including how to detect and prevent non-permitted data flows between hybrid infrastructure, the parent Region, and on-premises environments.

sessions.title: Applying the Well-Architected Framework to AWS Outposts and AWS Local Zones
sessions.abstract: AWS Outposts and Local Zones bring cloud closer to your users and data but introduce architectural decisions that do not exist in a purely cloud-native model. How do you design for resilience when infrastructure sits in your facility? What does security and cost optimization look like across hybrid topologies? In this chalk talk, we walk through the Well-Architected Framework pillar by pillar, exploring how each applies and where it bends at the edge. Bring your toughest design questions. We will draw out real-world patterns, discuss trade-offs, and build a practical mental model for well-architected hybrid solutions.

sessions.title: Designing Portable Multicloud Architectures with Open Specifications
sessions.abstract: Enterprises pursuing multicloud strategies often equate portability with containerization — but true architectural portability requires deliberate decisions across the full stack. In this chalk talk, we start from the foundational layers of compute, storage, and networking and build outward through data, security, observability, and AI. At each layer, we explore how open specifications enable portability — and in what parts of your architecture does portability matter most. Along the way, we challenge common myths: that managed services equal lock-in, that Kubernetes equals portable, and that open source alone guarantees freedom. Through interactive whiteboarding, we'll design portable architecture patterns together — examining real trade-offs, open specifications like Apache Iceberg, OpenTelemetry, OPA, and MCP, and how to make deliberate portability decisions across your stack.

sessions.title: GPU orchestration at scale using NVIDIA Run:ai across the edge
sessions.abstract: AWS and NVIDIA have collaborated for over a decade to deliver GPU-accelerated solutions from the cloud to the edge, yet Kubernetes still treats GPUs as opaque, unsharable integers. In this L400 code talk, learn how to deploy NVIDIA Run:ai on Amazon EKS and execute a complete model lifecycle on shared GPU infrastructure. Using Terraform, provision an EKS cluster with NVIDIA L4 nodes, install the Run:ai control plane and cluster agents, and configure project-scoped GPU quotas with priority-based sharing. Then see how Run:ai orchestrates a QLoRA fine-tuning job on Qwen3-14B and serves the resulting adapter with vLLM so you can compare base model responses against your fine-tuned model in real time. Leave with a reproducible pattern for maximizing GPU utilization across competing workloads without over-provisioning.

sessions.title: Implementing agentic AI solutions on-premises and at the edge
sessions.abstract: Learn how to extend Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to hybrid and edge services like AWS Outposts and AWS Local Zones to build distributed agentic apps using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication with on-prem data. Get hands-on with hybrid agentic AI using Amazon Bedrock and Strands Agents while exploring AWS hybrid and edge solutions for data residency compliance.

sessions.title: Self-managed agentic AI at the hybrid edge with AWS Outposts and AWS Local Zones
sessions.abstract: As organizations use agentic AI to automate complex infrastructure operations, many face constraints around data residency, low latency, and security that prevent reliance on cloud-hosted AI services alone. This session explores how customers deploy self-managed agentic AI at the hybrid edge to meet these requirements while unlocking autonomous operations. Learn how to provision, configure, and optimize AI agents across customer environments spanning AWS Outposts and AWS Local Zones. Attendees learn how to architect and operate AI agents that run locally, satisfying data sovereignty, latency, and security mandates while delivering intelligent, autonomous infrastructure management across hybrid environments.

sessions.title: Extend Amazon EKS clusters for on-premises and edge use cases
sessions.abstract: Dive deep into strategies for modernizing distributed applications with Amazon EKS across AWS Regions, AWS Local Zones, and AWS Outposts. This chalk talk demonstrates how EKS delivers a consistent experience across these deployment options, minimizing latency and enabling data residency. Through a real-world scenario, we'll deploy an application to an EKS cluster, showcasing seamless integration across distributed environments while maintaining a unified control plane. By exploring practical use cases and best practices, you'll gain actionable insights into architecting resilient and scalable applications. This session follows AWS Well-Architected Framework principles, helping you optimize your AWS deployments for consistency and security.

sessions.title: AWS Outposts at scale: Amazon Robotics fulfillment
sessions.abstract: Amazon Robotics operates AWS Outposts across hundreds of fulfillment centers, each supporting multiple teams with distinct workload requirements. In this code talk, learn how the team architects isolation on shared Outposts infrastructure, manages resource quotas across competing workloads, and implements high-availability strategies that keep robotic systems running through hardware and network failures. We walk through the team onboarding model, failover patterns between Outposts and the parent Region, and monitoring strategies that detect degradation before it impacts fulfillment operations. Leave with reproducible patterns for running shared Outposts at scale.

sessions.title: FanDuel: What we learned running containers on hundreds of AWS Outposts
sessions.abstract: Running containerized workloads across dozens of AWS Local Zones and hundreds of AWS Outposts demands operational patterns that hold up at fleet scale. In this session, learn how FanDuel operates Amazon EKS across a massive hybrid edge fleet with a focus on high availability, patching, observability, service-disruption handling, and autoscaling. We dive into how workloads respond gracefully to service-link and hardware disruptions, and how autoscaling behaves when capacity is constrained to physical racks. Discover the operational model that keeps a large edge fleet healthy without growing the platform team at the same rate.

sessions.title: Rivian's journey to Multi-Availability Zone factory resilience on AWS Outposts
sessions.abstract: Discover why Rivian chose AWS Outposts to support mission-critical manufacturing applications that produce vehicles at their Normal, IL plant. Explore how Rivian architected highly redundant infrastructure across multiple Outpost racks, leveraging fast EC2 provisioning and scaling to meet production line demands. We cover Multi-AZ deployment for high availability, RDS read replicas across racks for database resilience, and AWS DevOps Agent for proactiveobservability across their hybrid environment. Learn how Rivian plans to scale this model into their 9 million square-foot mega factory in Georgia.

sessions.title: Deployment strategies for highly available edge applications
sessions.abstract: Organizations need to be able to deploy critical applications that are highly available and fault-tolerant at the edge. These workloads are often some of the most demanding in terms of durability and availability requirements. Deploying workloads on AWS hybrid cloud and edge computing services like AWS Local Zones and AWS Outposts requires planning for networking, compute, storage, and other failure modes. In this chalk talk, dive deep into each of these services, review use cases, and examine reference architectures. Learn design considerations, deployment patterns, and best practices for high availability and disaster recovery.

sessions.title: How AWS Innovations is Shaping the Future of Telecommunications
sessions.abstract: For over a decade, AWS has worked to exceed the needs of the telecommunications industry. In this talk, Jan Hofmeyr, Vice President of Telecom at AWS, shares how AWS is building on that experience today and how new innovations are shaping the industry's future. Technical leaders from across AWS join him to dive into new capabilities that help you take leaps forward in what's possible. Through real-world examples and technical details, you will hear about the latest solutions for migration and modernization, network automation, customer experience, and capitalizing on growth opportunities in telecom.

sessions.title: Modernizing Care for the Underserved
sessions.abstract: This session explores how cloud migration unlocks AI-driven clinical decision-making, ensures continuous medical record availability, and expands access to care through new primary care models. Learn how AWS is helping modernize care delivery for the communities that need it most.

sessions.title: Semantic Layer for AI-Native Member Experience on AWS
sessions.abstract: Healthcare payers hold rich data across clinical records, claims, pharmacy, and behavioral signals in 10+ siloed systems, yet no intelligence layer connects them for AI agents. In this session, learn how payers are building a semantic layer transforming fragmented member data into a governed knowledge foundation for AI-native experiences.

sessions.title: How CMS Scaled Secure GenAI Assistants to 10K+ Users
sessions.abstract: CMS has deployed CMS Chat—an AI assistant built on Amazon Bedrock—to over 10,000+ users within a secure, PHI/PII-approved environment. The platform enables document summarization, text drafting, brainstorming, data analysis, code generation, and integration with tools like Jira and Confluence. At under $1 per user per month, CMS Chat saves employees roughly 5 hours weekly, compressing tasks that once took hours or days into minutes. This enterprise-wide rollout demonstrates how federal agencies can scale generative AI across highly regulated healthcare environments while maintaining strict security and compliance standards.

sessions.title: Modernizing Care for the Underserved: Montefiore's Cloud Journey
sessions.abstract:
Montefiore Einstein is one of New York's leading academic health systems, serving 1.3 million Bronx residents across 11 hospitals and 300+ ambulatory locations, where most patients rely on Medicaid and Medicare. To modernize its enterprise technology, Montefiore selected AWS as its strategic cloud provider—including migrating Epic, its EHR platform—building a secure, scalable, and resilient foundation that strengthens security and optimizes costs. This session explores how the transformation enables AI-powered clinical decision support, improves the reliability of critical medical records, and expands patient access through Amazon One Medical. Learn the strategies, lessons, and cloud-first approach driving better outcomes for the communities Montefiore serves.
"

sessions.title: Computing‑Power‑Cooling Synergy: Building the Future of Global Data Infrastructure
sessions.abstract: The rapid growth of AI workloads is driving new demands for large-scale data center infrastructure, with challenges in power supply, high-density cooling, and system integration. In this session, we will share real-world deployment practices and introduce end-to-end infrastructure solutions, including highly reliable UPS power systems, liquid cooling technologies, and turnkey integrated solutions. We will explore how computing, power, and cooling synergy can optimize data center efficiency, improve deployment agility, and accelerate the development of AI-ready infrastructure.

sessions.title: Evaluating AI agents for production in financial services
sessions.abstract: Financial institutions building AI agents face a core challenge: how do you prove an agent is reliable enough for production when regulators demand explainability and consistency? How do you reliably detect when a production agent's behavior drifts? In this chalk talk, we explore patterns for rigorous agent evaluation in regulated environments. We discuss defining ground truth, measuring agent quality with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations, and automating re-evaluation as prompts, tools, and parameters evolve. Leave with practical blueprints for constructing datasets, choosing metrics, and building continuous agent evaluation workflows for production.

sessions.title: Build multi-agent warranty and repair intelligence for automotive
sessions.abstract: Warranty and repair workflows span claim history, technical service bulletins, supplier quality records, and regulatory thresholds — a high-cost, fragmented data challenge for automotive OEMs. In this builders session, construct a multi-agent warranty and repair intelligence system using Strands SDK on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Build a triage agent that classifies incoming cases, a research agent that queries Bedrock Knowledge Bases across TSBs and repair records, and a resolution agent that synthesizes findings into a structured decision with cited evidence routed for technician approval via human-in-the-loop controls.

sessions.title: How Netflix auto-selects the right storage for every ML training workload
sessions.abstract: ML training workloads demand fast data access, but choosing between FSx Lustre, NVMe caching, and S3 direct reads is complex. At Netflix, we solved this by building an intent-driven storage layer that takes workload shape, dataset size, node count, access pattern, and automatically selects, provisions, and mounts the optimal storage engine. Our users write code once; the backend adapts transparently. In this session, we share the architecture behind our selection framework, how we built a high-throughput S3-to-NVMe hydration cache, and how you can apply the same pattern using generally available AWS storage services to reduce cost and eliminate storage guesswork.

sessions.title: AI for Impact: Elevating Human Potential Through Inclusive Innovation
sessions.abstract: Learn how California's Department of Developmental Services is leveraging AWS to modernize legacy systems and unify data for half a million individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) across 21 regional centers and acute care hospitals. See how this aligns with HR.1 (the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) requirements for government modernization within CA Health and Human Services. Explore responsible AI agents with fairness scoring and bias detection that improve equitable service delivery. Discover how multi-agent architectures on Amazon Bedrock enable transparent, auditable decisions for vulnerable populations — a replicable blueprint for ethical AI at scale.

sessions.title: Build a unified student insight platform on Amazon Quick
sessions.abstract: Every university role — advisors, deans, executives — needs student-success insights, but tools are disconnected. Learn how Amazon Quick delivers explainable, persona-aware analytics through natural language to identify at-risk students, trigger intervention, and generate executive-ready reports.

sessions.title: Mastering LLM tokenomics: From token costs to business outcomes
sessions.abstract: Financial institutions are scaling generative AI and agentic workloads to production and need strategies to keep costs aligned with business value. With enterprise workloads requiring retrieval, orchestration, validation, and governance layers, understanding token economics becomes critical to sustainable growth. In this chalk talk, we'll walk through design patterns for controlling token consumption while maintaining quality, including prompt compression, semantic caching with Amazon ElastiCache, tiered model routing with Amazon Bedrock, and cost attribution using Amazon CloudWatch. We'll whiteboard the hidden cost drivers in agentic AI systems and share design patterns that financial institutions use to control token consumption while maintaining quality.

sessions.title: Automate dispute resolution with Amazon Connect and Amazon Bedrock
sessions.abstract: Dispute resolution calls require agents to navigate multiple systems simultaneously, frustrating customers and driving up costs. In this session, integrate Amazon Connect with Amazon Bedrock to build an AI-assisted dispute workflow. Amazon Connect flows retrieve transaction context from Amazon DynamoDB while an Amazon Bedrock agent drafts resolution options ranked by policy compliance. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway manages tool calling with Cedar-based access policies and centralized observability across each interaction. Real-time transcription surfaces relevant account history and post-call summarization auto-populates the CRM. Implement PII redaction in call recordings, configure retention policies, and test escalation paths when AI cannot resolve a dispute.

sessions.title: Powering America's AI and HPC leadership for mission-critical outcomes
sessions.abstract: AI and HPC deliver real mission breakthroughs across defense, national security, and science. In this session, hear how AWS's $50B infrastructure investment and leadership-class hyperscale elasticity compress timelines from years to months. Ideal for mission owners, architects, and tech leaders.

sessions.title: Build a payment-enabled agent with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments
sessions.abstract: AI agents that can autonomously transact open new possibilities in financial services—from purchasing market data to paying for risk scores in real time. In this builders' session, you'll configure an AI agent using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments with the open source x402 protocol. You'll set up payment managers, connect to data providers, define budget controls with IAM policies, and monitor transactions with Amazon CloudWatch. Leave with a working agent that autonomously transacts, reasons about costs, and delivers results end to end.

sessions.title: Build stablecoin infrastructure from key management to agentic payments
sessions.abstract: Stablecoins are redefining payments and settlement infrastructure in financial services. In this  session, build a production-ready stablecoin infrastructure on AWS spanning secure key management with AWS Key Management Service and and AWS Nitro Enclaves, multi-signature governance workflows, token minting/burning/swapping operations, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments for autonomous agent-to-agent transactions. Get hands-on experience building wallet infrastructure and executing USDC stablecoin operations end-to-end. Walk away with a working architecture that bridges traditional key management with the emerging agentic commerce paradigm.

sessions.title: Event-driven AI agents for security triage with AWS Continuum
sessions.abstract: Security teams need to detect, correlate, and respond to threats faster than manual processes allow. In this chalk talk, explore how AWS Continuum orchestrates event-driven AI agents that triage, investigate, and escalate security incidents in real time. We walk through how alerts from Amazon GuardDuty and AWS Security Hub flow through Amazon EventBridge, triggering AWS Lambda functions that invoke agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with human-in-the-loop controls for high-severity events. Discover best practices for reducing alert fatigue, accelerating MTTR, and scaling security operations for financial services and other regulated industries where every response must be explainable and audit ready.

sessions.title: Modernizing Legacy Telecommunications OSS/BSS Systems
sessions.abstract: Legacy modernization is one of the most complex challenges facing Telecommunications companies today. In this Chalk Talk, we will explore strategies to accelerate VMware and mainframe migrations using Agentic AI. Using a real-world scenario, we will walk through how AWS Transform and Amazon Bedrock are used to meet the technical and business requirements of these projects and explore trade-offs in migration design and infrastructure choices. Come ready to discuss your own migration challenges!

sessions.title: Multi-Agent Operations for Broadcast & Streaming
sessions.abstract: When live or streaming video breaks, every second costs revenue and audience trust. This session shows how to build coordinated AI agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and the Strands SDK that ingest observability data from AWS Media Services and partners, reason across signal domains, and accelerate root cause identification. Walk away with an architecture for agentic operations that turns reactive troubleshooting into proactive resolution.

sessions.title: Best Practices for Successful Multiplayer Game Launches
sessions.abstract: The session covers best practices, architectural guidance and lessons learned for successful multiplayer game launches at scale. It's based on experience from helping hundreds of game customers from indie studios to AAA titles launch their games on AWS.

sessions.title: Automate disaster recovery with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
sessions.abstract: Financial institutions face stringent regulatory requirements for operational resilience, demanding reliable disaster recovery with tight RTO/RPO targets across complex application portfolios. Yet failover procedures often remain manual and prone to error under pressure. In this chalk talk, we explore how to design a multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that orchestrates end-to-end disaster recovery automation for regulated workloads. We’ll walk through how a coordination agent delegates to specialized sub-agents for readiness verification, infrastructure operations, Terraform code generation, Git operations, and deployment validation—each with human-in-the-loop approval gates.

sessions.title: Right tool, right layer: Combining ML models and autonomous agents
sessions.abstract: Financial institutions deploy dozens of models and manual workflows that struggle to work together at scale. Machine learning excels at fast, explainable decisions while agentic AI orchestrates multi-step workflows with reasoning and adaptability. Real value is knowing when to use each and combining them into one system. In this chalk talk, we present a decision framework and demonstrate an architecture where machine learning models score and detect while agents reason, act, and close the loop while delivering the auditability regulators require. We walk through a Know Your Customer (KYC) example, then open the floor. Bring your use case.

sessions.title: Telecom NOC operations: Automating incident response with AI agents
sessions.abstract: Modern telecom networks span thousands of distributed components, forcing network operations teams to interpret high volumes of alarms, separate root causes from downstream symptoms, and coordinate remediation across systems under time pressure. In this workshop, you will build AI agents that read, reason about, and execute Standard Operating Procedures for network deployment and remediation. First, deploy a 5G standalone core on Amazon EKS using an agent built with the Strands Agents SDK and Amazon Bedrock. Next, operate a closed-loop remediation agent, inject real failures, and observe how it detects, correlates, and resolves problems.

sessions.title: Physical AI in Telecom: A Framework for Workload Placement
sessions.abstract: Some physical AI workloads need sub-millisecond performance at edge cell sites, others are better suited to a full AWS Region, and many fall in between on AWS Local Zones or AWS Outposts. In this chalk talk, we provide a framework for matching each workload to the right option. We trace the physical AI development lifecycle, examining how data sovereignty, latency, data gravity, and token economics interact to shape placement decisions at each phase. Based on real-world use cases, we discuss the options so you leave with a placement framework you can apply immediately.

sessions.title: Telecom Contact Centers: Design Patterns for integrated AI Agents
sessions.abstract: Telecom customers demand fast, accurate service, yet IVR systems frustrate them, and when calls reach a human agent, context from the automated interaction is lost. Based on real-world implementations, this chalk talk explores alternatives to IVR using AI powered agents. We will walk through architectural options for customer facing agents built on Amazon Connect, how to pass conversation context to human agents when they step in, and options for integrating with OSS/BSS services using MCP and prebuilt integrations in Amazon Connect. We will examine the trade-offs that come with each design choice, so bring your questions!

sessions.title: Build self-healing agents from diagnosis to disaster recovery
sessions.abstract: Most AI agents stop at the root cause report, leaving engineers to act under pressure. In this workshop, build three cooperating agents on a pre-provisioned workload using Strands Agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with Amazon CloudWatch and Amazon Application Recovery Controller. A live app throws 4XX errors and a troubleshooting agent runs root cause analysis. Then build a remediation agent to apply the fix. When 5XX errors signal an Availability Zone impairment, you'll extend the remediation agent to consult a resilience agent before acting. Leave with a working reference implementation you can adapt to your financial services or enterprise environment.

sessions.title: How Blue Origin Built a Centralized Enterprise Knowledge Graph on AWS
sessions.abstract: Building enterprise AI applications shouldn't require every team to reinvent the wheel — standing up data pipelines, managing security, and keeping knowledge bases current. Blue Origin faced this at scale: dozens of teams, hundreds of data sources, and growing demand for AI apps that could reason across all of it. The answer was RAGNet — a centralized enterprise knowledge graph platform built on Amazon Neptune and Amazon Bedrock that aggregates structured and unstructured data into a secure, always-current graph any developer or AI agent can query in plain natural language.

sessions.title: Build a multi-agent system for hyper-personalized customer journeys
sessions.abstract: Delivering personalized experiences across complex customer journeys requires agents that understand intent, maintain context, and coordinate across systems. In this workshop, build a multi-agent AI personal banker using a home buying scenario as the example. Your agents extract intent from natural conversation, build dynamic customer profiles, and orchestrate workflows across internal banking systems and external ecosystem APIs. Implement multi-agent patterns for shared memory, readiness signals, and coordinated decisioning using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents Framework, and MCP. Walk away with reusable orchestration patterns you can apply to any personalized customer experience.

sessions.title: Patterns for mitigating AI-powered security threats in financial services
sessions.abstract: AI-driven vulnerability identification creates elevated risks for financial services organizations as attackers find and exploit software and configuration flaws at machine speed. Patching alone is no longer sufficient. In this chalk talk, we explore mitigation patterns that help financial institutions reduce exposure and strengthen their defensive posture. Walk through how Amazon Inspector, Amazon GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub, AWS Continuum, Kiro, and network isolation work together to detect, contain, and respond to AI-accelerated threats. Attendees will gain mitigation strategies and actionable next steps they can take back to their security teams.

sessions.title: How WBD Became the First Media Company to Go Agentic Across AdTech
sessions.abstract: Buying and selling media has long been manual, constrained by legacy systems and fragmented tools. Warner Bros. Discovery is changing that. As the first media company to integrate agentic AI workflows into every system across the media lifecycle, WBD is leapfrogging the competition by embedding autonomous agents at every step: planning, forecasting, optimization, and measurement. Built on AWS, this converged platform makes linear TV as addressable and measurable as digital. Learn how WBD and AWS are replacing decades of manual process with self improving agents that drive precision, yield, and entirely new monetization models at scale.

sessions.title: Content at the Speed of Live: AI-Powered Media Ops at Live Nation
sessions.abstract: Live Nation's subsidiaries generate petabytes of live event content across siloed storage. When an artist creates a viral moment, teams need it in fans' hands in minutes not days. In this session, learn how Live Nation built the AI Media Center on AWS, a platform that unifies fragmented media silos so teams can search, create, and publish at the speed of live. Built using the guidance for a Media Lake on AWS, along with Amazon Bedrock, the platform uses AI-driven moment detection to surface key content automatically. We cover architecture, lessons from festival-scale deployment, and impact on fan experience.

sessions.title: How Prime Video Built an AI-assisted Creative Suite on AWS
sessions.abstract: Premium animated series traditionally take 3.5 years to produce. Prime Video AI Studios built the AI-Assisted Creative Suite on AWS to compress production to under 12 months—and extend support to live-action shorts, second-unit VFX, and feature films. The suite is powered by AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and AWS Strands that select models, build creative workflows, construct prompts, and evaluate outputs. Learn how Prime Video trains and serves their first-party diffusion-model fleet on Amazon SageMaker and EKS, running on Amazon EC2 P6 GPU clusters for production-grade throughput and latency.

sessions.title: Real-time AI video enrichment with AWS Elemental Inference
sessions.abstract: Retrofitting videos to add subtitles, vertical formats, social cuts, and searchable metadata often means new encoders, manual editors, and multiple integrations. In this chalk talk, explore how AWS Elemental Inference can help extend reach, enhance engagement, and improve monetization by layering subtitling, vertical framing, key-moment clipping, and contextual metadata onto live and on-demand video without rebuilding your stack. Learn about the benefits of a single managed service that will improve latency, quality, and lower costs for video workflows.

sessions.title: KNFSD File Cache: Extending Your NFS Storage into the Cloud
sessions.abstract: Need to cache and serve NFS data from on-premises filers, across Availability Zones and Regions, or from other cloud providers with full read and write-back support? In this chalk talk, dive into KNFSD File Cache, an open-source, kernel-based NFS caching proxy on Amazon EC2 that transparently extends existing NFS storage into AWS. A single Terraform module stands up a production-ready, autoscaling cluster with high throughput and at low cost. We discuss hybrid and burst-compute patterns across M&E, HPC, Financial Services, and Life Sciences—eliminating latency without migration, client changes, or vendor lock-in.

sessions.title: How Citizens Bank reimagined CX with Amazon Connect and generative AI
sessions.abstract: Citizens Financial Group is transforming its customer service ecosystem using Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, and generative AI. In this session, learn how Citizens migrated legacy IVR and contact center infrastructure to Amazon Connect, deployed conversational AI across voice and digital channels, and integrated generative AI-powered agent assist and real-time conversation intelligence. We cover the solution architecture spanning Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, and Amazon EventBridge, along with measurable outcomes in containment rates, handle time, and routing accuracy. Attendees will gain a practical blueprint for enterprise-scale customer experience transformation in financial services.

sessions.title: How Ramp tracks and governs AI spend down to the team, model, and API key
sessions.abstract: When AI token spend spans multiple providers and dozens of teams, knowing who spent what, on which model, and whether it's COGS or OpEx requires its own pipeline. We'll cover ingesting usage data from third-party AI APIs, processing with Temporal workers, persisting on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, running on Amazon ECS Fargate, and surfacing anomalies before they hit your invoice. See how Ramp attributes spend by provider, model, team, and API key, and attributes cost down to the request-level when teams connect their router, gateway, or internal data. Learn how Ramp separates COGS from OpEx for accurate unit economics, then closes the loop with governance.

sessions.title: Don't rewrite your APIs: Make them agent-ready for agentic AI
sessions.abstract: Organizations want agentic AI, but valuable capabilities sit behind legacy APIs, AWS Lambda functions, and internal services. In this chalk talk, we explore practical, low-lift patterns for making existing endpoints agent-ready without replacing systems of record. Using a financial services scenario, we walk through how OpenAPI specs, AWS Lambda facades, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway expose existing endpoints as composable agent tools. We show how existing RBAC and OAuth scopes map into Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Cedar policies so you reuse your governance posture. Walk away with a 5-level maturity model you can apply to your own API estate.

sessions.title: Unifying fragmented data: A lakehouse for the agentic AI era
sessions.abstract: Financial services organizations face growing data volumes, strict regulations, and architectures where siloed warehouses and separate data lakes fragment data, drive up costs, and slow insights. In this chalk talk, we walk through a modern Lakehouse architecture on AWS that combines the cost benefits of data lakes with the governance and performance of data warehouses. We explain how Amazon S3 Tables with managed Apache Iceberg and AWS Glue Catalog semantic search deliver a single governed data foundation supporting agentic AI, traditional AI/ML, and analytics workloads. Learn practical patterns for a scalable Lakehouse you can apply immediately.

sessions.title: Talk to your market data: Agentic AI meets exchange feeds
sessions.abstract: In this builders’ session, connect an Amazon Bedrock agent layer to a high-performance data pipeline that turns 560M IEX exchange messages into an interactive playground. Analysts describe trading ideas in natural language (no SQL or Python required) while the agent queries Parquet data, generates strategy logic, runs backtests, and returns results. Dig into the C++ parsing, serverless orchestration with AWS Batch and AWS Fargate, Amazon S3, and guardrail patterns that make it production ready. Leave with architecture patterns, a cost model, and a blueprint for adding an agentic layer that takes anyone from market intuition to tested strategy in minutes.

sessions.title: Compete to build an AI agent with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
sessions.abstract: Organizations are ready to move beyond rule-based workflows to agents that reason, adapt, and act. In this gamified workshop, you'll use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to assemble a realistic conversational banking agent end-to-end: orchestration with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness; secure tool integration with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway; and guardrails with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy. Prebuilt modules accelerate development so you can focus on agent logic. Compete in real time as your agent's accuracy and efficiency are scored on a live leaderboard. Leave with a working agent pattern you can adapt to your own use cases and bragging rights on the leaderboard.

sessions.title: How Chamberlain and Daikin power smart product innovation with AWS
sessions.abstract: Manufacturers are transforming products into connected, intelligent offerings that deliver proactive, personalized customer experiences. Discover how AWS helps you build, connect, and monetize smart products at global scale. Hear how Chamberlain Group migrated its myQ smart home product platform, with 15M+ devices and 12M+ users, to AWS—eliminating multi-cloud complexity and furthering their AI and video intelligence offerings. Also learn how Daikin is using AWS to deliver 24/7 remote monitoring and predictive control across an extensive network of HVAC systems. Walk away with proven patterns for scaling connected products and unlocking AI-driven service revenue.

sessions.title: Collaboration Outside the Cage: How Amazon Deploys Autonomous Operations on AWS
sessions.abstract: Amazon deploys humanoids, autonomous mobile robots, and humans as a unified workforce operating side-by-side on the fulfillment floor. Learn how Amazon evolved an AI-powered verification pipeline, built with Amazon Nova on Bedrock to validate 200K+ items, into a fleet orchestration platform dispatching foundation-model inference across humanoids, quadrupeds, AMRs, and drones. We deep-dive into the architectural patterns enabling "life outside the cage" at scale: a serverless Lambda backend that abstracts the robot form factor, multi-vendor humanoid integration, and edge deployment strategies. You'll leave with a framework for physical AI orchestration of heterogeneous fleets while optimizing throughput and cost.

sessions.title: From Dial Tone to AI Agent: Build a Community Portal in 60 Min
sessions.abstract: City governments face rising citizen expectations with shrinking staff. In this hands-on workshop, deploy a fully functional AI-powered community portal using Amazon Connect in under 1 hour. Using speech-to-speech AI (Amazon Nova Sonic), you'll build a voice agent that answers common inquiries about permits, utilities, parks, and city services, routes callers to the right department, and escalates to live agents with full context when needed. No coding required. Leave with a production-ready reference architecture that your operations team can configure, deploy, and manage independently.

sessions.title: Build a governed semantic layer with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and MCP
sessions.abstract: Financial services organizations struggle with inconsistent metric definitions, AI hallucination risks, and analyst bottlenecks. In this session, you’ll build a governed semantic layer with three key pillars (accuracy, consistency, and explainability) essential for agents to operate securely at scale. You’ll then connect to AI agents powered by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that query, interpret, and act on financial data via MCP, enabling natural language access to complex financial metrics. Your agents reason rather than guess, with full auditability for financial regulators. Leave with a production-ready architecture pattern that goes beyond "chat with your data" demos.

sessions.title: Accelerate service onboarding with composable AI plugins
sessions.abstract: Service onboarding workflows consume hours across security, risk, and governance teams through manual approvals, evidence gathering, and threat modeling. These tasks are auditable, repetitive, and ripe for agentic decomposition. In this chalk talk, we walk through a composable AI plugin pattern that decomposes service onboarding into lightweight modules any agentic client can consume. We discuss how each plugin integrates with any agentic client to execute governance checks end-to-end. We share architecture patterns, working code examples, and show you how to reduce security review time. You’ll leave with a decomposition pattern and an open-source repo to get started.

sessions.title: Build an Agentic AI Marketing Engine Powered by Amazon Bedrock
sessions.abstract: In this hands-on builder session, construct a multi-agent AI system that automates the full marketing lifecycle—plan, launch, and optimize. Build specialized agents on Amazon Bedrock (planner, media buyer, analyst, and creative) that turn campaign parameters into data-driven recommendations: audience targeting, budget allocation, performance forecasts, and localized creative assets grounded in your brand guidelines and historical data. Activate campaigns through Amazon Ads DSP, then deploy an optimizer agent with human-in-the-loop approvals to reallocate budget across channels as performance shifts. Leave with a working blueprint for agentic marketing workflows using Amazon Bedrock and AWS Marketplace solutions—and become the marketeer of the future.

sessions.title: Breathing Life into Game Worlds with Amazon Neptune & GraphRAG
sessions.abstract: Static NPC dialogue can't unlock rich game worlds. This session shares a production pattern using Amazon Neptune, Bedrock GraphRAG, and the "Entity as Agent" approach. We live-demo natural-language character relationship search, in-character AI dialogue, and in-game party composition recommendations

sessions.title: Autonomous Swarms, Human Command: Building Trusted AI Teammates on AWS
sessions.abstract: Simulate commanding autonomous drone fleets for search-and-rescue using Amazon Bedrock Agents, IoT Greengrass, and SageMaker. We demo a Human-Machine Teaming architecture where AI operates autonomously within trust boundaries, escalating to humans via configurable confidence thresholds.

sessions.title: Agents Under Oath: HIPAA-compliant agentic AI on AWS
sessions.abstract: Agents expose PHI across five surfaces RBAC can't see: model responses, persistent memory, tool calls, RAG retrieval, and agent traces. This chalk talk walks a HIPAA-compliant reference architecture on AWS: four trust zones, sixteen controls mapped to Security Rule safeguards. Bring questions.

sessions.title: Implement AI agent safety controls with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
sessions.abstract: Scaling AI agents into production without safety controls creates compliance, cost, and operational risk for financial services organizations. In this workshop, build an agent safety control system using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Starting with a deployed agent, configure three signal pipelines: observability via Amazon AgentCore Observability and Amazon CloudWatch; cost monitoring with AWS Budgets; and Amazon AgentCore Runtime Evaluation for behavioral deviation detection. Then build an admin control panel that aggregates alerts and enables human-in-the-loop interventions including session termination and fine-grained authorization via Cedar policies. Leave with a proven approach you can replicate to deliver responsible, governed AI agents at scale.

sessions.title: Healthcare & Life Sciences AI Agents: From Spec to Demo in 120 Min
sessions.abstract: Healthcare and life sciences teams face pressure to apply generative AI but struggle moving from proof-of-concept to prototype. In this hands-on workshop, you use Kiro IDE and spec-driven development to build a functional AI agent—progressing through requirements, design, implementation, and live demo. Choose from four use cases: extract data from handwritten GMP batch records, orchestrate single-cell RNA-seq pipelines on AWS HealthOmics, identify clinical trial candidates using biomarker analysis, or build a patient access agent on Amazon Connect Health. You'll leave with a deployable agent, reusable specs, and a repeatable methodology for rapid AI development in regulated environments.

sessions.title: From static to self-improving agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
sessions.abstract: AI agents that learn from every production cycle deliver better outcomes without retraining or manual prompt tuning. In this chalk talk, we'll explore how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations scores live agent behavior across multiple quality dimensions and how the optimization capability discovers better system prompts and tool configurations from production traces. Learn how the agent improves continuously from production results, expert corrections, and revised context your team contributes. We'll demonstrate the full observe-evaluate-improve cycle with an underwriting agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and the Strands Agents Framework, then discuss how the pattern applies to claims, fraud, and customer service agents.

sessions.title: Agentic AI for software-defined vehicles: Compress the V-Cycle with Kiro
sessions.abstract: Automotive embedded software teams face complex V-Cycle workflows, safety standards, and competitive pressure to ship faster. In this workshop, experience how agentic AI transforms the embedded software V-Cycle — compressing timelines from weeks to hours without sacrificing quality or traceability. Attendees build a remote start/stop feature for an autonomous mower platform, using Kiro to orchestrate agents across requirements engineering, code generation, virtual-target testing, and test automation.

sessions.title: Securing AI agents: Governance patterns for regulated workloads
sessions.abstract: Financial institutions building agentic AI platforms face a fundamental problem: security and governance controls were designed for humans and applications, not autonomous agents. In this chalk talk, we'll whiteboard the architecture decisions that matter most—covering identity, authorization, secrets, tenancy, and governance—and classify each as a one-way or two-way door. We'll walk through concrete patterns including agent authentication, agent-to-tool authorization, application-layer data segregation, and a multi-source governance model using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon CloudWatch, and AWS CloudTrail. Leave with decisions you can apply to your own agentic platform.

sessions.title: In-Country HPC: How TGS Processes Seismic Data on AWS Brazil
sessions.abstract: TGS -- one of the world's largest multi-client geoscience data providers -- faced a significant cost challenge running its business-critical Rackmon EFWI GPU workload at scale. By strategically deploying this workload on AWS infrastructure in Brazil, TGS leveraged Brazil's ReData Special Tax Regime to dramatically reduce the tax burden on GPU-intensive seismic processing. The result: material cost savings on one of the most computationally demanding workloads in the energy industry -- and a reusable in-country processing architecture that can serve future customers with data residency requirements in other geographies.

sessions.title: Build hybrid data planes for government GenAI pipelines
sessions.abstract: Strict national security mandates block government agencies from adopting cloud GenAI. To resolve this, architects deploy a decoupled edge-to-cloud tokenization pattern. In this workshop, use AWS CDK to build a three-phase data plane that isolates sensitive citizen data in a simulated edge environment. You will deploy local data tokenization, route masked payloads to Amazon Bedrock for stateless inference, and reconcile state on-premises. Leave with an infrastructure-as-code blueprint to unlock frontier AI and satisfy federal localization mandates.

sessions.title: Agentic commerce: shopping assistants to agent-ready infrastructure
sessions.abstract: AI agents are reshaping how consumers discover and purchase products, and retail and CPG brands have a massive opportunity to meet them where they are. This chalk talk covers both sides of the agentic commerce stack. First, we walk through how retailers can launch conversational shopping customized to their catalog and brand voice in weeks with the Agentic Shopping Assistant on AWS, powered by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and inspired by Amazon's own AI shopping experience. Then we explore how to make your platform discoverable by external AI agents through structured product feeds, headless APIs, and payment orchestration for machine-initiated transactions.

sessions.title: Defeat Player Evasion: AI Moderation at Scale on Amazon Bedrock.
sessions.abstract: Players evade moderation with leetspeak, homoglyphs, emoji sequences, and fast-evolving slang. Brute-force AI classification catches evasion but is cost-prohibitive at scale. In this workshop, build a tiered moderation pipeline on Amazon Bedrock that routes 80–90% of traffic through deterministic normalization and pre-filters before invoking a model. Ambiguous content gets classified by Amazon Nova at sub-500ms latency. Only the hardest cases escalate to multi-agent analysis on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for context-dependent decisions. Configure per-category thresholds, instrument cost-per-decision tracking, and stress-test against real gaming evasion patterns. Walk away with a deployable, cost-optimized pipeline. Laptop required

sessions.title: Build agentic fraud detection with a transaction foundation model
sessions.abstract: Organized fraud rings exploit the gaps between siloed detection systems, making them invisible to traditional rules-based approaches. In this workshop, you’ll construct a fraud detection optimization system that tackles them at scale. Load 24M transactions into Apache Iceberg, build a knowledge graph with Amazon Neptune to reveal hidden fraud networks, and train an ensemble combining transaction foundation model embeddings with graph embeddings for measurable score improvement. Then deploy a multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that autonomously investigates patterns, expands fraud rings, and creates validated detection rules. Leave with an end-to-end working system you can replicate in your own environment.

sessions.title: Operational resilience in regulated environments with AWS DevOps Agent
sessions.abstract: As software delivery accelerates, financial services organizations struggle to manage incidents across fragmented toolchains. In this chalk talk, learn how AWS DevOps Agent acts as an always-on operations teammate for regulated environments—resolving incidents autonomously, strengthening systems proactively, and validating releases before they reach production. We'll whiteboard four patterns: how the agent investigates and resolves incidents in minutes; how the agent learns from past incidents to recommend improvements; how on-demand SRE tasks give your team instant operational intelligence; and how release readiness reviews catch compliance and dependency risks before code ships. Bring your operational challenges and leave with best practices.

sessions.title: Zero-Shot Demand Forecasting with Chronos 2, SMUS, and Quick Suite
sessions.abstract: Stockouts and overstocks quietly erode margin for retail and CPG brands, driving lost sales, markdowns, and working capital tied up in the wrong inventory. Traditional forecasting models take months to train and tune, and struggle with the cold-start problem for new products and locations. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard how to architect zero-shot demand forecasting pipelines using Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio with the Chronos 2 time-series foundation model, developed by the Amazon Science team and proven on Amazon's own retail and CPG demand at scale, requiring no historical model training. We walk through the end-to-end design: SMUS notebooks for rapid experimentation, Chronos 2 for multi-variate time series prediction, and Amazon Quick Suite for conversational analytics that let planners explore forecasts in natural language..

sessions.title: Building the semantic intelligence layer for enterprise AI agents
sessions.abstract: Every AI agent in the enterprise reasons better when it shares a common semantic understanding of the business. In this chalk talk, we show you how to build an Agentic Intelligence Layer that resolves meaning across every system and makes it innately consumable by any agent. We break down how to combine semantic embeddings, knowledge graph relationships, and natural-language memories into a single, governed layer that every agent reads from and writes back to. We take product and customer intelligence as the first domains and show how the same architecture extends to supply chain, operations, finance, and workforce. The result is a semantic intelligence layer that compounds learning across the business and transforms everything from demand forecasting to conversational commerce to enterprise decision-making.

sessions.title: Transform Episodic Content into High-Converting Micro-Dramas
sessions.abstract: Turn your episodic content into binge-worthy micro-dramas. In this session, you'll learn how to build both single- and multi-episode formats, multiply one source into a library of platform-ready content assets, and monetize a story in multiple ways — across ad-supported, subscription, and social distribution. We'll walk through scroll-stopping production techniques optimized for vertical, mobile-first viewing, and the pacing and cliffhanger patterns that drive completion and re-watch rates. Leave with a repeatable workflow for producing micro-drama series at scale and a clear playbook for turning your existing catalog into high-converting, agent- and platform-ready short-form video.

sessions.title: Innovate faster, stay compliant: Innovation Sandbox for financial services
sessions.abstract: Financial services organizations need to experiment fast while meeting regulatory and governance requirements. In this chalk talk, explore how organizations deploy Innovation Sandbox on AWS to give teams safe, ephemeral environments without compromising security posture. We’ll discuss real-world patterns for network isolation, automated guardrails via SCPs, and time-bound account lifecycles that satisfy risk committees and regulators. We’ll walk through how organizations balance developer autonomy with controls mapped to frameworks like SR 26-2 and OCC heightened standards, and you’ll leave with practical approaches for rolling out Innovation Sandbox on AWS while keeping compliance teams confident.

sessions.title: Production agentic trading: Orchestrating trade lifecycle on AgentCore
sessions.abstract: Energy trading teams juggle dozens of systems, manual handoffs, and time-sensitive decisions across the deal lifecycle. In this workshop, you'll learn how to architect an agentic workforce that orchestrates the full trade lifecycle in production — from market signal ingestion to real-time deal support to post-trade coordination across systems of record. We'll walk through agent design patterns, API integrations with Refinitiv, Allegro, Minerva, and Outlook, and what it takes to run mission-critical agentic workflows under strict latency and reliability requirements in a live trading environment. You'll leave with a reusable blueprint for deploying multi-agent orchestration in high-stakes energy trading operations.

sessions.title: Duke Energy: Human-Led, Agent-Driven Enterprise App Innovation on AWS
sessions.abstract: Duke Energy is pioneering a new frontier in software creation by combining human leadership with agent-driven execution using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and AppGen, its enterprise AI platform. Specialized agents enable both developers and business users to rapidly build production-ready, full-stack applications with speed and precision, driving millions in cost savings while accelerating innovation. This strategic, multi-year collaboration is transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated processes across business units. The approach supports scalable adoption of agentic AI while ensuring strong governance, reliability, and operational excellence—empowering teams to innovate faster, reduce complexity, and modernize systems consistently across the enterprise.

sessions.title: Modernize a Legacy Telecom Billing App with AWS Transform Custom
sessions.abstract: Got an old telecom application buried under decades of technical debt? In this hands-on session, you'll take a legacy BSS billing system and modernize it using AWS Transform Custom. Start by analyzing the codebase to understand business logic, dependencies, and technical debt. Then apply a built-in catalog transformation to upgrade the language and framework instantly. Next, define your own custom transformation in natural language to convert legacy interfaces to modern APIs. Validate, test for functional equivalence, and deploy to AWS. Walk away with a running modernized app and reusable transformation recipes, plus hands-on experience modernizing real-world telecom applications.

sessions.title: Build a Research Co-Scientist Using Amazon Quick
sessions.abstract: Learn how to build your own co-scientist with Amazon Quick. In this builder session, you'll gain hands-on experience with loading life sciences domain skills directly into Amazon Quick, and work through your own scientific questions with guidance from AWS's life sciences experts. You'll leave with firsthand experience on bringing expert-level reasoning to everyday research workflows.

sessions.title: Don't ban it, broker it: Govern AI coding agents with Amazon Bedrock
sessions.abstract: AI coding agents are becoming embedded in development workflows. In regulated environments (e.g.,financial services), that raises concerns around data residency, code exfiltration, auditability, and runaway costs. But banning the tools creates shadow AI. In this session, we'll whiteboard a better path by pointing AI coding agents at Amazon Bedrock through a gateway in your VPC. One control point for identity, data residency, prompt inspection, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, cost controls, and immutable audit. We'll walk through the request lifecycle, debate trade-offs around latency, budgets, and MCP tool calls, and show how the same broker pattern governs any agent touching sensitive data.

sessions.title: Emerging multi-agent patterns for complex financial workflows
sessions.abstract: Multi-agent systems are rapidly evolving beyond static orchestration patterns. In this chalk talk, we explore the newest collaboration paradigms gaining momentum, including ephemeral agent patterns and self-improving agents, alongside established approaches like hierarchical, sequential, and peer-to-peer coordination. Walk through how to apply these patterns to claims adjudication, underwriting, and financial portfolio advisory using Strands Agents and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness engineering best practices. We'll discuss when to select each pattern, how to combine them for complex workflows, and how AgentCore harness capabilities enable scalable, governed multi-agent architectures. Gain practical guidance for designing the next generation of agentic applications.

sessions.title: How to Deploy Purpose-Built Clinical AI Agents to Production with Speed and Scale
sessions.abstract: Providers lose hours daily to documentation, manual coding, and admin work. Leading health IT builders are solving this with purpose-built AI on AWS. Some train task-specific small language models that deliver consistent clinical outputs where general-purpose LLMs produce unacceptable variance. Others embed fully managed AI agent capabilities into their software to reach production faster. Many do both. In this chalk talk, we walk through flexible AWS architecture patterns for each path: custom model training on accelerated compute, multi-step agentic workflow orchestration, and embedding fully managed clinical AI capabilities into existing applications.

sessions.title: Agentic AI in Production: Natera Saves Lives, Cuts Costs, Grows Revenue
sessions.abstract: Natera, a global leader in cell-free DNA testing for oncology, women's health, and organ health, built reusable agentic infrastructure on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore to power multiple internal platforms from a single framework. Natera's VP of Engineering shares the technical decisions behind this infrastructure and provides a blueprint for building once and scaling across your organization. See a live demo of one platform built on this foundation for revenue cycle management, cutting prior-authorization denial rates 6x, reducing touchpoints by 5x, and enabling new use cases to go live in under a week.

sessions.title: How Mercedes-Benz accelerates engineering and production with AI
sessions.abstract: Mercedes-Benz is using agentic AI on AWS to transform how vehicles are brought to life, from engineering to production. Hear how Mercedes-Benz is using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to accelerate engineering for 14,000 engineers—building specialized AI agents that reason over millions of interconnected artifacts, compressing specification generation by 90%, from 35 weeks to 3.5. On the factory floor, discover how Mercedes used AWS to build a fully cloud-native manufacturing execution system orchestrating 1M+ vehicles annually, with AI-powered quality intelligence providing rapid root-cause analysis and digital twins helping optimize throughput. Walk away with real-world lessons for deploying industrial AI at scale.

sessions.title: Scaling Multi-Account IAM at Netflix: Access, Visibility and Credentials
sessions.abstract: Managing IAM across a large, fast-growing AWS footprint quickly outgrows manual review — every permission change creates friction for engineers and queue time for operators. We'll cover a control-plane approach that ties together high-level IAM abstractions, automated workflows, and business context to drive the majority of AWS access needs. Developers describe intent against concrete resources instead of hand-writing JSON; Access Analyzer–backed probes auto-approve routine changes; administrators get a single pane of glass over SCPs, identity and resource policies, CloudTrail/S3 errors, and AWS Config history. Credential delivery flows through the same plane, enabling context-aware scoping for human and agentic callers alike.

sessions.title: Decision patterns for AI Agents with Amazon Connect Customer
sessions.abstract: Contact center AI agents require critical architecture decisions around tool integration, voice prompt engineering, and quality evaluation. In this chalk talk, we'll explore when to use first-party tools, when AWS Lambda gives you more flexibility, and when MCP integrations make sense—with latency, operational complexity, and compliance requirements as the deciding factors. We’ll discuss patterns for voice prompt engineering with Amazon Connect Customer AI agents and automated evaluation pipelines using Contact Lens and generative AI to score 100% of interactions. You'll leave with a decision model you can apply to your own contact center, including guidance for financial services and regulated industries.

sessions.title: Enterprise-Ready: How NetEase Governs AI at Scale
sessions.abstract: Learn how NetEase, one of the world's largest gaming companies, is building enterprise AI governance as AI adoption scales across the organization. Discover how Amazon Bedrock enables multi-model routing, cost controls, and team-level budget management to optimize AI usage. See how NetEase enforces governance with company-wide AI policies, Bedrock Guardrails for content safety, and Bedrock AgentCore for orchestrating agentic AI workflows with centralized governance and observability. Learn why a platform-first approach to cost, access, and safety is critical for enabling AI innovation at enterprise scale.

sessions.title: An Epic Tale: Hyperscale Storage & Compute for the Fortnite Ecosystem
sessions.abstract: The metaverse will not be built by one studio. It will be built by thousands of teams shipping petabytes of content, running millions of build and render jobs across regions every day. The engineers behind Lore, Epic's distributed version control system for massive binary repositories, and Overmind, a multi-region ephemeral compute orchestrator, reveal the AWS architecture that makes it possible: self-managed scheduling on EC2, S3/DynamoDB/Keyspaces/Aurora for the data plane, EKS-hosted control planes running durable workflows, and MSK for replayable event streams. Leave with a concrete reference architecture and lessons on tenant isolation, regional sovereignty, and global platform scale.

sessions.title: Transforming from a Connectivity  Provider to an AI Delivery Channel
sessions.abstract: Explore how a leading carrier built an AI delivery channel embedding intelligence directly into voice networks for real-time, contextual services. Discover their ultra-low-jitter wireless network enabling Physical AI workloads at scale using Bedrock and SageMaker across AWS Regions, Local Zones, and Outposts.

sessions.title: Behind the Scenes: Building the Telecom Concierge
sessions.abstract: Whether you caught the demo on the expo floor, or you are enhancing your customer service systems with AI, this chalk talk dives into the architectural decisions powering a hyper-personalized customer experience. Explore the intelligent routing and retrieval trade-offs, and understand the business model implications when operators can shrink their physical footprint without degrading experience. Leave with a reference framework for designing context-aware systems at scale, a decision matrix for your retail strategy, and clarity on the ROI drivers so you can architect similar solutions in your network.

sessions.title: How Novartis is Using AI to Reimagine Clinical Development on AWS
sessions.abstract: Developing a new medicine takes 10–15 years and $2.6 billion — and the timeline is getting longer, not shorter. At Novartis, the Global Drug Development organization recognized that incremental optimization of siloed, sequential clinical processes wouldn't be enough. In this session, learn how Novartis is transforming clinical development with AWS by replacing fragmented legacy systems with a unified NextGen Data Platform. You'll also learn how Novartis stood up an Intelligent Decision System that simulates entire trial operations as a computational twin, and pioneering a collaborative Trial Design Studio where biostatisticians, clinical operations, regulatory, and medical teams co-create protocols in real time.

sessions.title: Physical AI for MedTech: From Intelligent Devices to Business Impact
sessions.abstract: Physical AI — AI that senses, reasons, and acts in the physical world — is reshaping medical devices. From surgical robots to connected infusion pumps, imaging to wearables, every next-gen device needs training, simulation, edge deployment, and fleet management at scale. In this chalk talk, we’ll architect the full Physical AI stack on AWS for medical devices — SageMaker for model training, IoT Greengrass for edge inference, regulated OTA at fleet scale, and NVIDIA solutions integrated into the AWS backbone. We’ll whiteboard the hard tradeoffs — edge vs. cloud, regulatory constraints, and scaling from prototype to 100K devices. Leave with a reference architecture and a clear path to pilot

sessions.title: Deploy a HIPAA-Compliant AI Agent with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
sessions.abstract: Your clinical team wants an AI agent that summarizes patient notes—but one leaked SSN means a $1.5M HIPAA penalty. In this session, we build a working Amazon Bedrock Agent with HIPAA controls baked in. Guardrails automatically redact low-risk identifiers and block critical PHI, routing flagged content through Amazon EventBridge to an SQS review queue. AWS CloudTrail captures the full audit trail, and IAM restricts the agent to BAA-covered services only. You leave with a deployable CDK stack ready for production.

sessions.title: How Bayer designed 50K proteins on Amazon Bio Discovery
sessions.abstract: This chalk talk explores how to architect agentic AI workflows for generative protein design at enterprise scale. Using Bayer's oncology nanobody campaign as the reference implementation, we walk through the technical and scientific decisions behind a pipeline that generated 50,000 candidates and 3,000 prioritized candidates in weeks using Amazon Bio Discovery. Topics include: model orchestration patterns for generative and predictive models, designing scoring functions that encode biological mechanism (not just binding affinity), iterative feedback loops between computation and wet-lab validation, and scaling considerations for enterprise drug discovery programs. Attendees will leave with a reusable architectural blueprint for building agentic biomolecule design workflows on AWS.

sessions.title: From Millions of Gamers to AI at Scale: Roblox's Hybrid AWS Architecture Unleashed
sessions.abstract:
"Auto-scaling was only the beginning. At Roblox, scaling means continuously adapting to changing capacity, hardware availability, GPU constraints, and unpredictable global demand.
Join Roblox to learn how they combine AWS with on-premises infrastructure to dynamically place workloads across regions, architectures, and AI providers. Using EC2 Capacity Health Visualizer, hybrid scheduling, multi-region load balancing, self-hosted AI inference alongside Amazon Bedrock, and heterogeneous compute (x86, Graviton, Inferentia, Trainium, GPUs), you will learn how Roblox keeps gaming and AI services responsive under record-breaking load."

sessions.title: Real-World AI: How a State Agency Transformed Its Contact Center
sessions.abstract: When the Georgia Department of Community Supervision needed to modernize their contact center, they turned to Amazon Connect and AI. In this session, hear firsthand how AI-powered call analysis, real-time transcription, automated case notes, and intelligent agent assistance are transforming how state agencies serve constituents. We share lessons learned from discovery through implementation, including how to prioritize high-impact AI use cases, build stakeholder alignment, and deliver measurable outcomes. Leave with actionable strategies to bring AI-driven contact center innovation to your organization.

sessions.title: Mastercard: Training a Large Transaction Model on billions of transactions
sessions.abstract: Traditional fraud models depend on brittle, hand-crafted feature pipelines that break down as transaction volume grows and fraud patterns shift. Mastercard took a different approach: a transformer-based foundation model pre-trained on billions of anonymized payment sequences, treating transaction history the way language models treat text. This session covers the architectural decisions behind the Large Transaction Model (LTM), the challenges of tokenizing tabular financial data at scale, training on AWS distributed accelerated compute, and the path to production inference.

sessions.title: Replacing eligibility rules engines with Neurosymbolic AI in HHS
sessions.abstract: State HHS agencies spend hundreds of millions maintaining eligibility rules engines built on Drools or proprietary tooling. These systems are brittle, expensive, and impossible to audit. We built a different path: Ingesting policy, using Large Language Models, and building a formal logic representation, followed by using neurosymbolic techniques to produce a verified rule set, enabling deterministic eligibility decisions with full audit trails. No hallucinations. Provable correctness. We walk through the architecture, show a working prototype processing SNAP and Medicaid policy, discuss pricing at scale, and share early results from state engagements.

sessions.title: How the IRS modernized tax amendments with generative AI
sessions.abstract: The IRS processes millions of amended tax returns annually through a legacy rule-based engine with less than 10% accuracy — forcing 90% into manual review and creating 10+ week delays. Hear directly from IRS and AWS on how they deployed an agentic AI solution on AWS GovCloud using Amazon Bedrock to process returns in one day, automate routing and adjustments, and maintain human-in-the-loop governance. Learn the architecture, compliance journey, and lessons delivering production-grade generative AI in a federal environment.

sessions.title: Accelerate your GenAI mission from prototype to ATO in weeks
sessions.abstract: Every agency wants GenAI in production, but few have navigated the path across classification levels. In this Chalk Talk, learn real-world patterns for deploying Bedrock agents and foundation models across Government Regions - service parity, ATO strategies, and tradeoffs. Ideal for architects.

sessions.title: How the Air Force Defends DoD Workloads with Amazon Bedrock Agents
sessions.abstract: AWS built STORMS with the Air Force SOC to defend DoD workloads across AWS accounts in multiple Organizations - pairing centralized security telemetry and one-click containment with a multi-agent Amazon Bedrock system that analyzes logs, answers analyst questions, and executes containment actions.

sessions.title: Build, simulate, and validate physical AI-driven robotic systems
sessions.abstract: Commissioning industrial robots typically takes weeks of physical testing. Digital twins with real-time physics simulation and multi-agent AI optimization can compress that timeline from weeks to hours.
